Subject: Q3 senior-leader slate: signoff + conditional offer plan

Team — attaching the proposed senior-leader slate for Q3 and a conditional-offer template Sarah recommended. High level: we’re planning 4 executive-level hires in Q3 (VP Eng, VP Product, Head of CS, Director of Infra) with the following asks:

- Approve headcount and proposed comp bands for each role (sheet: Q3_senior_slate_matrix.xlsx).
- Confirm permission to issue conditional offers (2-week window contingent on final references and security clearance).
- Budget note: these are covered within the Q3 hiring envelope if we accept the suggested comp bands; deviations >10% require exec approval.

Specifics:
- VP Eng: Level E7, target base 280k, OTE 380k, 12-month equity target 0.6% (range 0.45–0.75).
- VP Product: Level E7, base 260k, OTE 350k, equity 0.45% (range 0.35–0.6).
- Head of CS: Level E6, base 200k, OTE 260k, equity 0.25% (range 0.18–0.35).
- Director, Infra: Level E5, base 170k, OTE 210k, equity 0.12% (range 0.08–0.18).

Ask: if you can reply with APPROVE / APPROVE WITH NOTES / OBJECT by EOD tomorrow (2027-05-21 17:00 PT). If no objection, Sarah will go ahead and prepare conditional offers for finalists.

Attachments: Q3_senior_slate_matrix.xlsx (breakdown by role, comp band rationale), conditional_offer_template.pdf (legal-cleared template; placeholders for variable comp).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Ben — thanks for the summary and the clear asks. I reviewed the matrix and I AM OK WITH THE PROPOSED BANDS for VP Product, Head of CS, and Director Infra. A couple of notes on VP Eng:

- The equity target feels slightly low given market comps for E7 in SF; recommend we hold target at 0.6% (not 0.45%). If we do 0.6% we should tighten the base by 10k to stay within budget.
- For conditional offers, please ensure the offer letter flags the background check and the data-handling appendix (we need to include our standard SOC2 appendix).

I APPROVE WITH NOTES for the slate, pending Ben's confirmation on adjusting the VP Eng equity and the inclusion of the SOC2 appendix in the template.

1) VP Eng equity: I agree with Laura that 0.6% is reasonable for market parity. If we increase equity, we should cap sign-on cash to keep TCO predictable.

2) Compensation bands: can we get a one-pager that maps these bands to internal leveling (IC vs manager track) and to our total comp modeling for 24 months? We need that for finance forecasting. If HR can produce the one-pager today I can sign off after a quick review.

3) Conditional offers: legal wants the exact placeholder language for references & clearances in the template (Sarah, can you include a redline to the conditional_offer_template.pdf?)

If we get the above, I am likely to APPROVE.
